description: Defines the class LeaveRequestDatesDetail, a data transfer object (DTO) for handling details related to leave request dates, including from and to dates, duration, and start/end times.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDatesDetail
classes.description: A DTO representing detailed information about leave request dates, including date ranges, duration type, and start/end times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fromDate and optionally toDate.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of the leave request.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of the leave request.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the optional end date of the leave request.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the optional end date of the leave request.

methods.name: getDurationTypeId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the duration type.

methods.name: setDurationTypeId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the duration type.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Returns the duration type as a string.

methods.name: setDurationType
methods.description: Sets the duration type as a string.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time for the leave period.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time for the leave period.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time for the leave period.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time for the leave period.
